reviewRule: reviewerId and implementerId must be nonempty canonical identities, must differ, and review must explicitly assert independence and PASS
candidateRule: evidence and current candidate inputs must declare the same nonempty canonical candidateId as well as matching digests
metadataRule: all six digest values in evidence and current inputs must be SHA-256 64-hex strings; capturedAt must be a valid date string; policyVersion must be a nonempty canonical string identity
retainedRule: the manifest CLI checks READY_FOR_REVIEW/PASS status and retained regular output files with matching checksums; structural validation is not release authorization
exportRule: export and deploy entrypoints require an external trusted runner, reviewer-controlled pin with separately supplied checksum, exact staged identity, independent review and fresh mandatory checks; absent, failed or stale evidence blocks release
